card.name: Linking words in drug-interaction statements
card.fires_on: Small linking or helper words (are, a, whether, is, any, may, showed) in hedged sentences about unknown or possible effects and interactions in drug labels.

modes.label: Uncertainty phrases
modes.description: Words after 'It is not known' or 'not identify' that lead into an unresolved question.
modes.example: It is not known<< whether>> this potentiation of ampicillin r

modes.label: Possible interaction wording
modes.description: Helper or article words in 'may be a ... interaction' or 'properties that may enhance' statements.
modes.example: Clindamycin has been shown to have neuromuscular blocking properties that<< may>> enhance the action of other neuromus

modes.label: Study result verbs
modes.description: Verbs or determiners introducing findings of interaction studies.
modes.example: Sulfonylureas Clinical Impact: In vivo drug interactions studies<< showed>> a decrease in sulfonylureas

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes a few odd words and suppresses test and verification words.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in hedged sentences about whether a drug interaction or effect exists.
